headline: Rentokil Initial Jumps on Reassurance 2026 Profit Will Meet Forecasts
summary: Shares in Rentokil Initial climbed after the British pest control and hygiene services group confirmed it expects 2026 profits to match market expectations.
why: Rentokil Initial is a constituent of the FTSE 100 and one of the world's largest commercial pest control and route-based facility service providers.

impacts.name: Rentokil Initial
impacts.why: Reaffirming that 2026 earnings will satisfy consensus estimates relieved investor concerns about potential profit shortfalls.
